scenes.heading: EXT. VILLAGE DIRT ROAD - MORNING
scenes.action: Golden morning sunlight cuts through misty coconut trees. CHINNI, an 8-year-old girl in a navy-blue pinafore and twin red-ribbon braids, skips down the red-dirt lane, schoolbag bouncing. DEVI catches up with quick steps, adjusting her glasses with a laugh.
scenes.dialog:
CHINNI: Hurry up Devi, the school bell will ring soon!
DEVI (laughing): Wait for me, Chinni!
